hypotheses_tested: H1 (r3 major 1 regression) — a BigInt or cyclic payload survives structuredClone and makes JSON.stringify throw out of `apply` after the commit, leaving an un-undoable edit. REJECTED: three probes (BigInt entry, cyclic entry, cyclic theme) all return without throwing, with rev/undoDepth coherent and the edit reversible; `measure` (commands.ts:757) is total and mutant M1 proves two tests pin that.

H2 (r3 major 2 regression) — `apply([])` still bumps rev, clears redo, or pushes a phantom entry. REJECTED: rev/undoDepth/redoDepth/canRedo/redoLabel all unchanged across an empty batch, prior redo still executes and restores the edit; mutant M2 proves the guard is pinned. Also checked the transaction path: an empty batch while a transaction is open commits nothing.

H3 (r3 minor regression) — a throwing get-trap Proxy still escapes as a raw throw. REJECTED: typed `not-cloneable` error returned as a value, rev 0, document identical by reference; index-based message; mutant M3 pins it. Batch position 2 also leaves the document untouched (no partial application).

H4 (new, ordering honesty) — the 'defense-in-depth' hoist is actually load-bearing and the builder undersold it, or is dead and the builder oversold it. BOTH REJECTED: M4 reds nothing (confirming it is unobservable alone) and M5 reds only what M1 already reds (confirming it is not observable even in combination), which is precisely the caveat written at history.ts:255-261.

H5 (new, unmeasurable-charge direction) — `UNMEASURABLE_BYTES` could under-charge and let a hostile payload defeat the soft byte cap, or over-charge and evict real history. REJECTED as a defect: the 64 KB flat rate is strictly above the alternative (0/overhead) the code replaced, the comment at commands.ts:745-748 claims only that direction and not an upper bound, and hostile payloads cannot arrive from any real producer — the IPC and §6 journal paths hand over JSON.parse output. Probe confirms 65665 bytes charged, and eviction never drops the newest entry (history.ts:429).

H6 (new, blast radius) — some other consumer depends on `apply` always bumping `rev` or on `commandBytes` throwing. REJECTED: grep over src and tests shows `DocumentHistory` and `commandBytes` have zero production call sites — `DocumentSession` does not exist yet — so the only consumers are the tests. The whole changeset is Electron-free pure logic reachable from vitest, per 70-testing-ci.md.
